# CtrLang

> Türkçe backend web dili. Saf C, SQLite, Mongoose.

## Dokümantasyon
- [README](https://github.com/darking053official/CtrLang/blob/main/README.md)
- [Dil Referansı](https://github.com/darking053official/CtrLang/blob/main/docs/dil-referansi.md)
- [Gramer](https://github.com/darking053official/CtrLang/blob/main/docs/gramer.md)
- [Örnekler](https://github.com/darking053official/CtrLang/tree/main/ornekler)

## Nedir
CtrLang, Türkçe anahtar kelimelerle yazılan bir backend web dilidir.
PHP ve Node.js'in Türkçe alternatifi.

## Örnek
```ctrlang
sunucu başlat(3000)
sayfa "/" {
    yazdır "Merhaba"
}
```

Kurulum

curl -fsSL https://darking053official.github.io/CtrLang/install.sh | sh

Lisans

GPL-3.0
